title: 第一卷 第7章 初次交锋大获全胜第一卷 第8章 侯府震惊天生剑灵体
lines: “不准你这么说我娘！”
姜牧野年仅三岁，但此刻眼神却无比狠厉，怒瞪着府医。
府医心知这是侯府的麒麟孙，得罪不起，只能打着马虎眼道：“也许是巧合吧，二人之间天生犯冲，才导致了意外。”
姜文康与老夫人自然明白府医说的是实话，而且周丽婷是个什么德性，他们也清楚。
奈何人家肚子争气啊，生了个天才。
叶琉璃倒是知书达理，性格极佳，可生出来的孩子是个平庸之辈，能对侯府有帮助吗？
因此，老夫人当即警告府医道：“此事决不许外传出去，就说丽婷是自己不小心弄伤的，听明白了吗？”
“明白，明白。”府医连连擦汗。
周丽婷却不肯善罢甘休，歇斯底里道：“母亲大人，如今我这张脸都被毁了，您可得给我做主啊！”
看着周丽婷腐烂而狰狞的半边脸，老夫人感到一阵恶心，嫌弃后退了几步，看向府医道：“她的脸如何医治？”
府医道：“还好叶无尘只是个婴儿，如果他再长大几岁，可能这伤就无法挽救了，但现在只需要辅以膏药，静养个两年即可治愈。”
“两年，我竟需要静养两年？”
周丽婷气得怒发冲天，何曾受过这等委屈，怒指向叶无尘道：“我要杀了这个小畜生！”
“丽婷，你冷静一点，尘儿只是个刚出生的婴儿，你和他计较什么啊。”
姜文康连忙将周丽婷拦住。
叶琉璃则觉得好笑道：“你若不去抢夺尘儿的玉坠，尘儿会吐你口水吗？作茧自缚，活该！”
“就是，依我看，尘儿做得就很棒！”
叶蓉凤双手抱在胸前，骄傲的昂起头来，心里面只觉得痛快。
“我不管，这乾坤坠必须戴在我儿子身上当做赔偿，否则今日之事，绝对没完！”
周丽婷开始张牙舞爪，她才是西院的当家主母，而今凭什么在叶琉璃这受委屈？
“丽婷，你别无理取闹了！”
此刻，连姜文康都已经看不下去。
已为人妇，居然和一个刚出生的婴儿斤斤计较，说出去也不怕被外人笑话。
“我无理取闹？好好好，我无理取闹，你看看我这张脸，都伤成这样了，你还不管不顾，行啊，看来在这侯府我是待不下去了，现在我就带着儿子离开！”
周丽婷情绪激动，说着就要抱走姜牧野。
这一下子，老夫人的软肋又被戳中了。
她当即看向叶琉璃道：“琉璃，你就大度一点，将乾坤坠交给牧儿佩戴，算是借的还不行吗？”
“大度？”
叶琉璃柳眉挑起，只觉得好笑，当初她只想保住腹中孩子，老夫人却将她往死里逼！
现在开始提大度二字了！
不过转念一想，叶琉璃直接取下了叶无尘怀中的玉坠，交给老夫人道：“我丑话可说在前头，乾坤坠乃叶家至宝，其中孕育的神力并非谁都能承受的，若是姜牧野承受不住玉坠的能量，导致受伤，可怪不得我！”
周丽婷怒斥反驳道：“笑话，我家麒麟儿乃七品灵根，大帝之姿，叶无尘一个平庸之子都能承受乾坤坠的力量，我儿没理由承受不住！”
“不错，既然尘儿戴着无事，牧儿肯定能行。”
老夫人也在一旁连连点头，七品灵根，这可是千年不世出的强大天赋，必能征服乾坤坠，让其认主。
“好，我言尽于此，既然你们还是盲目自信，那试一试便知了。”叶琉璃摇了摇头，心想这两个女人当真无知，都被利益冲昏了头脑。
老夫人接过乾坤坠后，一脸激动，连忙来到姜牧野身旁道：“牧儿，这乾坤坠可是当世至宝，可让你的天资更上一层楼，你将来可得勤加修炼，将同龄人远远甩在身后！”
姜牧野骨子里便透着一股骄傲与自信，“奶奶您就放心吧，以我的天资，注定一飞冲天，无人可挡！”
content_en:
"You are not allowed to say that about my mother!"
Jiang Muye was only three years old, but his eyes were extremely fierce at this moment, glaring at the doctor.
The doctor knew that this was the Qilin grandson of the Hou family and could not afford to offend him, so he could only say carelessly: "Maybe it's a coincidence. There was a natural conflict between the two, which led to the accident."
Jiang Wenkang and the old lady naturally knew that the doctor was telling the truth, and they also knew what kind of character Zhou Liting was.
However, she was so ambitious that she gave birth to a genius.
Ye Liuli is well-educated and has an excellent personality, but the child he gave birth to is mediocre. Can he be helpful to the Hou family?
Therefore, the old lady immediately warned the doctor: "This matter must not be spread outside. Just say that Li Ting was injured accidentally. Do you understand?"
"I understand, I understand." The doctor wiped his sweat repeatedly.
But Zhou Liting refused to give up and said hysterically: "Mother, my face is ruined now, you have to make the decision for me!"
Looking at Zhou Liting's rotten and ferocious half of her face, the old lady felt nauseated. She took a few steps back in disgust, looked at the doctor and asked, "How to treat her face?"
The doctor said: "Fortunately, Ye Wuchen is just a baby. If he had grown a few years older, the injury might have been irreparable, but now he only needs to be supplemented with plaster and rest for two years to cure it."
"Two years, I actually need to rest for two years?"
Zhou Liting was so angry that she had never been so wronged before. She pointed angrily at Ye Wuchen and said: "I want to kill this little beast!"
"Li Ting, please calm down. Chen'er is just a newborn baby. Why are you arguing with him?"
Jiang Wenkang quickly stopped Zhou Liting.
Ye Liuli thought it was funny and said: "If you don't snatch Chen'er's jade pendant, will Chen'er spit on you? You deserve to be trapped in a cocoon!"
"That's right, in my opinion, Chen'er did a great job!"
Ye Rongfeng clasped her hands on her chest and raised her head proudly, feeling only happy in her heart.
"I don't care, this Qiankun Pendant must be worn on my son as compensation, otherwise today's matter will never be over!"
Zhou Liting started to show her teeth and show her claws. She was the mistress of the west courtyard, so why should she be wronged by Ye Liuli now?
"Li Ting, stop making trouble unreasonably!"
At this moment, even Jiang Wenkang couldn't stand it anymore.
She is already a married woman, yet she is so preoccupied with a newborn baby that she is not afraid of being laughed at by outsiders if she talks about it.
"I'm making trouble unreasonably? Okay, okay, I'm making trouble unreasonably. Look at my face, it's so hurt. You still don't care. Okay, it seems I can't stay in this house any longer. Now I'll take my son and leave!"
Zhou Liting was so excited that she wanted to take Jiang Muye away.
At this moment, the old lady's weakness was poked again.
She immediately looked at Ye Liuli and said, "Liuli, please be more generous and give the Qiankun Pendant to Mu'er to wear. Isn't it okay to count it as a loan?"
"Generous?"
Ye Liuli raised her eyebrows and thought it was funny. At first, she just wanted to keep the child in her belly, but the old lady pushed her to death!
Now let’s start mentioning the word generosity!
However, after thinking about it, Ye Liuli directly took off the jade pendant from Ye Wuchen's arms, handed it to the old lady and said, "I'm going to say something ugly first. The Qiankun Pendant is the Ye family's most precious treasure. Not everyone can bear the divine power contained in it. If Jiang Muye cannot withstand the energy of the jade pendant and gets injured, you can't blame me!"
Zhou Liting angrily retorted: "It's a joke. My Qilin'er has a seventh-grade spiritual root. He has the appearance of a great emperor. Ye Wuchen, a mediocre son, can withstand the power of the Qiankun Pendant. There is no reason why my son can't bear it!"
"Yes, since Chen'er is fine wearing it, Mu'er can definitely do it."
The old lady also nodded repeatedly. The seventh-grade spiritual root is a powerful talent that has not been seen in thousands of years. It will surely conquer the Qiankun Pendant and make it recognize its master.
"Okay, that's all I have to say. Since you are still blindly confident, just give it a try and you will know." Ye Liuli shook his head, thinking that these two women were really ignorant and were all dazzled by the benefits.
After receiving the Qiankun Pendant, the old lady looked excited. She quickly came to Jiang Muye and said, "Mu'er, this Qiankun Pendant is the most precious treasure in this world. It can take your talent to a higher level. You will have to practice diligently in the future to leave your peers far behind!"
There was a sense of pride and confidence in Jiang Muye's bones, "Grandma, don't worry, with my talent, I am destined to soar into the sky and be unstoppable!"
